title: Model check state
description: The weekly model check's state (index key model_check_state; F2c F): whether the check is paused (set when no link of a role could be checked, cleared only by the owner's `model_check.py resume`) and when each connection's model list was last read. Written on the host only, by bin/model_check.py. Never the source of a pick or a rollback: the trusted event line is. A file that cannot be read or does not pass this schema counts as paused (fail closed).

listed.description: Per connection id: when its model list was last read.
